pre-run.claim: Invocation, lexical and whole-program refusal; include invalid unused bodies.
pre-run.nearest_wrong: Wrong cause or first offending UTF-8 byte.

value-order.claim: Returned values, left-to-right fields, repeated references, report-local node order and ordinary names.
value-order.nearest_wrong: Reversed fields or separate nodes for equal children.

decimal.claim: Addition, truncated subtraction and multiplication of obtained naturals under the selected budgets.
decimal.nearest_wrong: Subtraction for addition or addition for multiplication.

wrong-kind.claim: A fully paid wrong-kind arithmetic call returns ordinary builtin none. An unpaid edge preserves its prefix.
wrong-kind.nearest_wrong: Free wrong-kind edge at one-short fuel, or an invocation refusal.

calls-order.claim: Forward and recursive calls, variable reads and written argument order through the chosen stop.
calls-order.nearest_wrong: Right argument first, or an unpaid call executed for free.

atomic-debit.claim: Earlier debits stand and the first unaffordable invoice consumes zero. Include a paid boundary counterpart.
atomic-debit.nearest_wrong: An omitted debit returns a result, or a failed invoice spends fuel.

resources.claim: Finite source and value caps and real file/report I/O. Account at the first failing boundary.
resources.nearest_wrong: Dropping the observed limit, completed execution or failed operation.

record-binding.claim: Match the actual file, argv, subject, build identity, candidate profiles and raw streams for this run.
record-binding.nearest_wrong: A record from the adjacent source or another build, input or profile passes.
